A '''cartoon''' was released in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="TSOTFW">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref> between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> It featured a [[Mission to Panna Prime|mission]] undertaken by the Alliance [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], on [[Panna Prime]], where they encountered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The cartoon was narrated by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kazan]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[RS Revenge]].<ref name="TSOTFW" /> It was edited and released by the Alliance, and Chewbacca gifted a copy to his [[Parent/Legends|son]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]], who cherished the recording and watched it frequently,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III||Panna system}}</ref> including during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Holiday">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The cartoon appeared in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'', written by [[George Lucas]] and animated by [[Nelvana]] studios.<ref name="Tooning Out">{{SWArchive|url=movies/saga/20081210.html|text=Tooning Out the "Holiday Special": Nelvana Studios}}</ref> and aired in [[1978]] as part of ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.<ref name="Holiday" />
